hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.emptyBody: Hosts you add appear here. Double-click one to open a Terminal.
hosts.newDescription: Keys in ssh-agent are tried first, then the private key file, then the password or the server's own questions (such as a one-time code). When asked for a password or passphrase, you can save it in the system keychain.
hosts.credentialsCleared: Saved credentials cleared. The next connect asks again.
hosts.terminalSchemeHint: Give production Hosts their own colours so they are hard to mistake.
hosts.editDescription: Change how sshastra connects to this Host.
hosts.deleteHostBody: The Host is removed from the list. Terminals already open on it keep running.
hosts.deleteGroupBody: Its Hosts and Groups move up one level. Nothing inside is deleted.
hosts.noResultsBody: Search looks at names, addresses and users.

import.title: Imported ~/.ssh/config
import.skipped: Skipped: a Host with this name already exists

problems.jumpChainConflict: Its ProxyJump chain reaches {{hop}} differently from {{hop}}'s own settings
problems.jumpHostLoop: Its Jump hosts lead back to itself
problems.jumpHostUnavailable: Its Jump host {{hop}} was not imported

transfer.exported: Host list exported. Passwords and passphrases are never included.
transfer.imported: Import done. Hosts added: {{hosts}}. Groups added: {{groups}}.
transfer.skipped: Skipped because a Host with the same name exists: {{names}}.
transfer.exportFailed: Could not export the Host list: {{message}}

workspace.emptyBody: Open a Host from the list, or start a Local terminal on this computer.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.description: Open a Host, switch tabs or run an action.

files.title: Files
files.empty: Open a Terminal on a Host to browse its files here.
files.dockRight: Dock File panel on the right
files.dockBottom: Dock File panel at the bottom

edit.title: Open in editor
edit.editing: Open in your editor. Saves upload automatically.
edit.noApplication: No application on this computer opens this file.
edit.notAFile: Only regular files open in the editor.

tooLarge.title: Too large to edit
tooLarge.body: {{name}} is larger than 10 MB, the most that opens in the editor. Download it instead?

binary.title: Not a text file
binary.body: {{name}} does not look like text. Editing it may damage it. Download it, or open it anyway?

errors.timedOut: The server did not answer in time.

files.name: Name

nameProblem.dots: “{{name}}” cannot be used as a name.

delete.count_one: {{count}} item will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.count_other: {{count}} items will be deleted, including everything inside folders. This cannot be undone.

operationErrors.notOpen: The File panel is not connected.

conflict.title: This file already exists
conflict.body: A file with the same name is already at the destination. Replace it?

forwards.title: Port forwards
forwards.lead: Forward traffic through {{host}}'s Connection: reach its network from here, expose a port of this machine on it, or use it as a SOCKS proxy. A running Port forward keeps the Connection open, even with no Terminal.
forwards.emptyBody: Add a Port forward to reach a service behind this Host (such as a database), expose a local port on it, or browse through it as a SOCKS proxy.
forwards.restartHint: Changes apply the next time it starts.
forwards.actionFailed: Could not save the Port forward: {{message}}

startErrors.portInUse: Port {{port}} on {{address}} is already in use. Choose another local port, or stop the program using it.
startErrors.permissionDenied: Not allowed to listen on port {{port}}. Ports below 1024 usually need administrator rights; choose a higher one.
startErrors.remoteRefused: The server would not listen on port {{port}} ({{address}}). It may be in use there, or the server's AllowTcpForwarding / GatewayPorts settings forbid it.

local.targetHost: As the Host sees it, for example localhost or db.internal.
local.bindAddress: Leave blank to accept connections from this machine only (127.0.0.1).

remote.targetHost: As this machine sees it, for example 127.0.0.1.
remote.bindAddress: Leave blank to accept connections from the Host itself only (localhost).

dynamic.bindAddress: Leave blank to accept connections from this machine only (127.0.0.1).

kindHints.local: A port on this machine that reaches an address on the Host's side (ssh -L).
kindHints.remote: A port on the Host that reaches an address on this machine's side (ssh -R).
kindHints.dynamic: A SOCKS5 proxy on this machine; the Host opens each connection (ssh -D).

forwards.autoStartHint: Runs whenever this Host connects: opening a Terminal, starting another Port forward, or Connect only.

terminal.pressEnterToRestart: Press Enter to start a new shell.

paste.title: Paste {{count}} lines?
paste.body: The shell may run each line as soon as it arrives. Check the text before pasting.

hostKey.title: Unknown host key
hostKey.body: This is the first Connection to {{host}}. Check that this fingerprint is the server's before trusting it.
hostKey.hint: Trusting adds the key to ~/.ssh/known_hosts, shared with the ssh command.

password.title: Password for {{user}}@{{host}}
password.description: Used to sign in to this Host.
password.label: Password

mismatch.title: Host key has changed. Connection blocked
mismatch.body: {{host}} presented a different key than the one recorded. Someone may be intercepting the Connection, or the server was reinstalled.
mismatch.fix: If you are sure the change is legitimate, remove line {{line}} of {{path}} yourself, then connect again.

errors.timedOut: The Host did not respond in time.
errors.hostKeyDeclined: The host key was not trusted. Not connected.
errors.hostKeyRevoked: The host key is revoked. Connection blocked.
errors.keyUnreadable: Could not use the private key {{keyPath}}: {{reason}}
errors.keyPassphraseIncorrect: Wrong passphrase for the private key {{keyPath}}.
errors.keyRejected: The server rejected the private key {{keyPath}}.
errors.agentKeysRejected: The server rejected every key in ssh-agent.
errors.noSupportedMethod: No usable sign-in method. The server accepts: {{methods}}.

save.label: Save in the system keychain
save.unavailable: No system keychain is available, so this is asked for each time.

keyboardInteractive.title: {{user}}@{{host}} asks
keyboardInteractive.description: The server asks for more information to sign in.

lost.title: Disconnected
lost.newShell: Reconnecting starts a new shell; programs running before are gone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Changes apply right away and are kept after a restart.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: System follows your computer's light or dark setting.

language.label: Interface language
language.description: System uses your computer's language when sshastra has it, otherwise English.

font.label: Font
font.description: A CSS font list; the first font installed on this computer is used.

ligatures.label: Ligatures
ligatures.description: Joins character pairs such as -> and != when the font supports it.

colorScheme.label: Colour scheme
colorScheme.description: Used by every Terminal unless its Host sets its own.

copyOnSelect.label: Copy on select
copyOnSelect.description: Selecting text in a Terminal copies it to the clipboard.

rightClickPaste.label: Right-click paste
rightClickPaste.description: Right-clicking in a Terminal pastes the clipboard.

confirmMultilinePaste.label: Confirm multi-line paste
confirmMultilinePaste.description: Ask before pasting more than one line, since the shell runs each line as it arrives.

shellIntegration.label: Shell integration
shellIntegration.description: Remote bash and zsh Terminals opened from now on tell the File panel when you cd, so it follows. Turning it off stops every File panel following at once and types nothing into new shells; Sync to Terminal folder still works.

keepalive.label: Keepalive interval
keepalive.description: How often an idle Connection checks the server is still there. A dropped Connection is noticed after three missed checks. Applies to new Connections.

concurrency.label: Simultaneous transfers
concurrency.description: How many uploads and downloads run at once; the rest wait their turn. A folder's files copy one after another.
